scope: All known pre-cutoff V54 waits with early FULL submit and ACK, not only the selected 18 queue tails.
This remains an early-transfer-selected population; non-transferred opportunities are not included.
Native arrival is taken from exact sealed whole-request attribution; absent arrival remains unknown.

No runtime, global lease, admission quota, ETA, output budget or workload configuration changed.
